{{Otheruses|Trap}}
'''The Trap''' was a room at [[Exovar's Emporium]] dedicated to [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]] and [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]]. Established by [[Kaori Batta]], it contained hunt trophies. The central exhibit was a stuffed [[Modrol|ice modrol]] that Batta himself had killed.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
